instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.sch` is the schematic to modify. Add three net classes and save the schematic as `/home/user/Desktop/classed.sch`. Required classes: - `SIG` with width about `0.15 mm` - `PWR` with width about `0.40 mm` - `HSPEED` with width about `0.20 mm` Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/classed.sch` must parse as EAGLE XML. 2. `<classes>` must contain classes named `SIG`, `PWR`, and `HSPEED`. 3. Their widths, normalized to millimetres, must be approximately `0.15`, `0.40`, and `0.20` respectively. 4. The three added classes must have distinct `number` attributes. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
